BillHeading.BriefDescription: Regulating sewage grinder pumps for new residential buildings.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to regulating sewage grinder pumps for new residential buildings; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35A.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 36.01 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 57.02 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) No city or town may prohibit the installation of sewage grinder pumps for new residential buildings that:
(a) Are located below grade of a public sewer line;
(b) Are connected to a low-pressure sewer system;
(c) Are located at a distance from a public sewer line that gravity alone cannot effectively move wastewater to the public sewer system;
(d) Must move wastewater vertically;
(e) Are located in a new residential community where geologic site conditions or excessive topography cannot support the expense of a gravity sewer system.
(2) For purposes of this section:
(a) "Sewage grinder pump" means a system connected to a residential building's wastewater system that collects, grinds, and pumps residential sewage into the public sewer system.
(b) "Low-pressure sewer system" means a wastewater system that requires pressure from sewage grinder pumps to transport wastewater.
